# Synthetic sample

`lecture.pdf` is generated by `python tools/make_sample.py`. It contains three simple text slides about study methods and a fourth page with only geometric shapes. The fourth page exercises the unsupported-page warning.

`cards.json` contains hand-written draft cards for this fixture. It is not generated by a live model and must never be used as evidence of AI quality. The “Try a sample lecture” action imports these drafts without using a provider account.
